description: NemoClaw reasoning-model providers. Example only: copy the values into the NemoClaw runtime's own config. API keys are NEVER stored here — each provider names the environment variable that holds its key in the runtime's credential provider. All three are OpenAI-SDK compatible, so one adapter with a different base_url serves all of them. Verified 2026-09-25.

meta.name: Meta Model API (Muse Spark)
meta.notes: Meta's first-party API; public preview for US developers since 2026-07-09. $1.25 / $4.25 per million input/output tokens. Default for the Meta track. Muse Spark is a reasoning model and is unrelated to the rejected 'Meta Muse Image' image-generation backend.

xai.name: xAI Grok API
xai.notes: Default for the Resilience Commons (Grok) track. Pick a vision-capable Grok model from docs.x.ai/developers/models for identify_subject and set NEMOCLAW_VISION_MODEL; image-input support varies by model.

nebius.name: Nebius Token Factory
nebius.notes: Open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, gpt-oss and more). Choose a model ID from the Token Factory catalog that supports tool calling (and a vision model for identify_subject); record the exact IDs here once chosen.
